name: Disgaea Infinite
original_name: ディスガイア インフィニット
source: A visual novel based on the [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disgaea]Disgaea[/url] RPG series. The story shares many characters with the games, but focuses on a Prinny trying to solve a murder mystery.
translation: 一部以[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disgaea]《魔界战记》[/url]RPG系列为基础的视觉小说。故事沿用游戏中的许多角色，但重点讲述一只普利尼试图解开谋杀谜案的过程。
